newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 29.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Sumitomo Bank Ltd plans to sell 800 billion yen in loan credits as securities in Europe and Japan.
-- Japan and South Korea to resume fisheries talks next month.
-- Hitachi Ltd to build 150 billion yen next-generation memory microchip plant in Hitachinaka city, Ibaraki Prefecture.
-- Hospital chief in Osaka arrested in fraud case.
-- Japan will not propose CO2 target at preparatory meeting in Bonn.
-- Finance Ministry to announce penalties against Nomura Securities Co Ltd and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) over payoff scandal.
-- Japan may send team to monitor Cambodia's general election next May.
